caption: The drawing depicts a folded piece of fabric positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The fabric displays a repeating pattern of wide horizontal stripes in three colors: red, blue, and beige. The patterns within the stripes consist of ornate, decorative floral and scroll motifs, with the beige areas having more intricate, leafy designs, while the red and blue bands contain larger, stylized floral and geometric shapes. The fabric is depicted with realistic texture, showing slight fraying along the right and lower edges and a portion of a fold at the upper left. The layering of the fold adds depth, and the texture is emphasized by subtle shadowing. The predominant colors in the fabric are muted red, dark blue, beige, and white, set against the neutral, unadorned background.
title: Eagle Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
